notes.title: v.1.2.0 - Balance Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
This time I tried to tweak balance to make it easier to play on a Hard difficulty and to make the gameplay as fun and challenging as possible.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Overall speed of the balls is decreased
[*]Hitbox is now 50% smaller (visually it stayed the same, but physically it's now smaller)
[*]Removed can't-hit-after-miss cooldown
[*]Hitting empty hitbox is now the same as missing the ball
[*]HP loss after missing the ball became smaller and HP gain after hitting the ball became higher
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fix[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed boy animation bug, when he could be frozen at one frame
[/list]

It's a very important update for me, because I'm not very strong at gamedesign and tweaking all those numbers. I hope the game will be better with those changes.
Feel free to share your opinion on these changes here on Steam or on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/PGcAZCh]Discord [/url]server.

Have a nice day!

Hitbox is now 50% smaller (visually it stayed the same, but physically it's now smaller)
Hitting empty hitbox is now the same as missing the ball
HP loss after missing the ball became smaller and HP gain after hitting the ball became higher

notes.title: v.1.1.0 - Huge UI Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Huge update is here. Let's do a quick overview of it!

[h1]User Interface[/h1]
[h3]Colors[/h3]
Every piece of interface now consists of one or more of 4 main colors - pink, yellow, black and white.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568556/e6bdd68b2d303849d9e4e129af63d108e81fb4cd.png[/img]

[h3]Shapes[/h3]
Clickable items have [i]almost[/i]-parallelogram shape. Other non-interactable pieces, like backgrounds or additional graphics, have similar shape. But some of them are different, like this lighting-shaped Settings menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568556/5c2f328662b0771e139ea4d9c27d2033b9dfe956.png[/img]

[h3]Animations[/h3]
When you open another part of the main or gameplay menu, it will have a short transition animation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568556/41c67fc89e235b31137e4fb4ddbd26d5e0828849.png[/img]

[h1]New Languages[/h1]

I've added 3 new languages to the game - Japanese, Korean and Traditional Chinese. Every game looks immediately cooler when it has Asian languages!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568556/9aa45eb9bdf8ca15107aea9ef20773365a5ad5f3.png[/img]

[h1]P.S.[/h1]
There is still a lot of work to do to make this game much better. Bug fixes, balance, VFXs.
Since the last year I started working in a gamedev company, so I don't have much time to work on Kovox Pitch and Lofi Ping Pong. But every time I have a free evening, I sit down to work on my games.

My next goal is to make a balance patch - the thing that I never considered important in my games, but now I do.
I hope you're doing great, have a nice day! And don't forget to join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/PGcAZCh]Discord[/url]

tags.feature: Every piece of interface now consists of one or more of 4 main colors - pink, yellow, black and white.
Clickable items have [i]almost[/i]-parallelogram shape.
When you open another part of the main or gameplay menu, it will have a short transition animation.
I've added 3 new languages to the game - Japanese, Korean and Traditional Chinese.

notes.title: Kovox Pitch goes 3D (somewhat)
notes.content:
So, hello girls and boys! It's your regular show "Yet another visual update of Kovox Pitch".
In todays' episode we have:
[list]
[*]Brand new background (again). But now it's [strike]fooly[/strike] fully 3D with lights, post processing and stuff
[*]Compact UI that is 100% better than the previous one, but still not perfect (I'll improve from time to time)
[*]Ambeint sounds that are super quite but still you can [i]feel[/i] them (if you don't, press Esc during the game and you'll hear 'em)
[*]Many other tiny stuff that you won't notice
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568556/cbd86ac9410215acc6c4a4aae25ba881dbd6f2a2.png[/img]

But the most exciting thing for me is that from now on I'm not working alone! Yea, of course I had some freelance artists before, but most of them were not interested in the game (excluding one person, hi CAMA). The second pilot is a great artist and even better 3D-stuff-doer. That's why we decided to make all backgrounds in 3D - not only it will give us so many possibilities, but it'll fulfill my desire to combine photos with 2D stuff. I know that 3D models are quite different from photos, but still it's a very great mix! I already have some rendering problems because of that mixture, but it's a great opportunity for me to learn something new.

I hope you guys like the new visuals! FYI, I'm working on more gameplay features and from this day I finally start to build a Story mode.
If you have any questions, compliments, concerns etc. - you can share them with me here or on our Discord channel https://discord.com/invite/PGcAZCh

notes.title: New Demo version
notes.content:
Hello everyone. In this blog post I want to showcase new features that I've added.
Last version of the demo was launched on 31.07.20 and after that I was working on Lofi Ping Pong Switch version. I finished it in the middle of December and after that I was 100% on Kovox Pitch.
So, in the last 6 weeks I added:

1. Gameplay features.
Red and blue balls like in classic taiko. You can hit Red balls only with Z (left) button and Blue balls only with X (right) button. White balls, which you can hit with both Z and X, are still in the game.
Now there is a second line for balls (rear moped). In the last demo I wanted more depth, tried to make it visually with parallax, but in the end it turned into this gameplay feature.

2. Graphics.
I decided not to use photos as backgrounds (it was a hard solution). For the last year I tried to make visuals using photos but I didn't succeed. We will draw all the backgrounds by hand, the video shows the first try.
The vespa has also been redrawn - adjusted to the perspective, and now it is full-size (people who have 21:9 monitors saw in the last demo that the moped was completed only to the middle).

[previewyoutube=_gtcxhtO0y0;full][/previewyoutube]

3. Settings.
When choosing a track, it is possible to simplify the game - change the speed of the ball, remove colored balls, etc. Also I added a menu with basic settings such as volume and fullscreen. In addition, you can play with the camera parameters and set the cap for the FPS.

4. Calibration
A thing that many wrote about on Ping Pong (maybe I'll add it there later too). Now you can test and set offsets for audio and video. Dunno, whether it is working properly now, let's look at the tests from the players.

In addition, I fixed old bugs (and added new ones), plus I changed the tracks a little again, there are 5 of them, but slightly different than in the previous version.

Play the demo, leave your suggestions and bug repoprts here on Steam or on [url=https://discord.com/invite/PGcAZCh]Discord channel[/url]

When choosing a track, it is possible to simplify the game - change the speed of the ball, remove colored balls, etc.
Also I added a menu with basic settings such as volume and fullscreen.
In addition, you can play with the camera parameters and set the cap for the FPS.
Now you can test and set offsets for audio and video.
